title: Beautiful MD
summary: A browser-based Markdown workspace for styling, checking, and exporting documents.
outcome: Give Markdown authors a direct path from draft to a styled, shareable document.
status: Browser app and private Workspace add-on testing
lead: Write in Markdown, preview a typeset page, and export a document suited to print, editing, or sharing.
challenge: Markdown makes drafts portable. Preparing one for print or handoff still takes work, especially when the document has charts, local images, tables, or page breaks.

flow.detail: Paste Markdown or import a folder or document package. A zipped Google Docs HTML export provides another path for documents with images.
The browser parses and sanitizes the document, applies typography and print layout, and reports broken links, missing images and invalid charts.
IndexedDB keeps named documents, attachments, and recoverable drafts in the browser. Export options include styled PDF or PNG, browser-print PDF, editable Word, and a portable ZIP.
The Apps Script sidebar supports native actions in Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Gmail plus a handoff to the browser renderer.

decisions.decision: Keep the standalone renderer and document library in the browser.
decisions.tradeoff: Document processing stays local. Recovery depends on the same browser profile unless the user exports a package.
Styled, print, and editable outputs each preserve different aspects of the source. Preflight can flag those differences before export.

limits: The release checklist records tests on a private Workspace installation. Public Marketplace availability and parity with the public web deployment remain unverified.
